declaredAdvisories.reason: The three warehouse-confirmation operations (GET, PUT and DELETE /api/v2/org/agent-permissions/projects/{projectUuid}/warehouse-confirmation) and the exported AgentWarehouseRestrictionConfirmation and AgentWarehouseConfirmationStatus types are removed. The agent-identity flag is off by default on Cloud and on self-hosted. The endpoints refuse callers when the flag is off. Only the project Agent identity settings page of the same release called them. API clients get a 404. Raw SQL for agents no longer needs a project confirmation.
